IronForest_Text_Npc0.en: The leaves cut. Wear long sleeves.
IronForest_Text_Npc0.fr: Les feuilles coupent. Porte des\nmanches longues.

IronForest_Text_Npc1.en: SCIZOR is my hero. It is also my\nnightmare.
IronForest_Text_Npc1.fr: CIZAYOX est mon héros. C'est aussi\nmon cauchemar.

IronForest_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

IronForest_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
IronForest_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
